title: Product Detail Page
description:
<custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-0">:person_with_crown:</custom> **User Story:**

**As a** customer,  
**I want** to view detailed information about a product,  
**so that** I can make an informed purchasing decision.

* **Product Information Display**

    * The page must show the product name, price, short description, and high-quality images.
    * A longer product description and technical specifications (if applicable) should be available.
    
* **Image Gallery**

    * Users can click through multiple product images.
    * Zoom-in functionality should be available on desktop.
    
* **Variants**

    * If the product has variants (e.g., size, color), dropdowns or buttons should allow the user to select these options.
    * The page should update the price, image, or availability according to the selected variant.
    
* **Stock Status**

    * Show whether the product is in stock, low stock, or out of stock.
    
* **Add to Cart Functionality**

    * Users can add the product to their cart by selecting the desired variant (if applicable) and quantity.
    * Clicking "Add to Cart" gives immediate feedback (e.g., confirmation modal or banner).
    
* **Shipping and Returns Info**

    * Display estimated delivery time and return policy details (optional).
    
* **Related Products Section**

    * Display recommended or similar products below the main content.

enrichedData.purpose: Customers need comprehensive product information including images, variants, pricing, and availability to make informed purchasing decisions.
useCases: View product name, price, short description, and high-quality images
Access longer product description and technical specifications
Click through multiple product images in a gallery
Zoom in on product images on desktop
Select product variants using dropdowns or buttons
See updated price, image, and availability based on selected variant
Check stock status (in stock, low stock, out of stock)
Add product to cart with selected variant and quantity
Receive immediate feedback after adding to cart
View estimated delivery time and return policy
